besluite.rede: 'wat hulle moet doen' is the natural Afrikaans form and says exactly the same thing.

besluite.fout: the trait's name follows 'is egter' directly as a bare verb phrase, so the sentence stumbles on a first reading
besluite.rede: The colon marks the list item as a quoted name, leaves the protected wording intact and changes no meaning.
'Die eienskap vra dat' is natural Afrikaans for 'requires', and 'beteken' turns a demand of the trait into a definition of it, which moves the claim.
'na die span se idees vra' is standard Afrikaans, and 'die beste een' brings back the English calque a previous round judged a fault and the writer replaced on purpose.
